name: Episode Limit
overview: Stop playback after X files - perfect for falling asleep!
description: Adds a bedtime button to the video player that lets you set how many files to play before automatically stopping. Works with episodes, movies, anything! Fork by Seekeer: works with the native player of the official Android app.

versions.changelog: Конец screen after the limit stops playback
